member.name: M:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms.EditContext.ValidateAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Validates this asynchronously. Cancels any pending field-level async validation tasks, invokes the synchronous handlers, then invokes and awaits the asynchronous handlers concurrently. Exceptions from synchronous handlers propagate to the caller, matching . Any non-cancellation exception thrown by an asynchronous handler is contained: the form is marked as faulted (observable via the parameterless ) and the method returns false. While the asynchronous portion is in flight, the parameterless returns true so applications can show a global "validating..." indicator without wrapping the call themselves. The form-level result is updated only when a pass completes; it is preserved across caller-cancelled passes.
member.param: A token that signals cancellation of this validation pass. The token is exposed to async handlers via . If the caller cancels the token, this method throws ; the form is not marked as faulted in that case and the previous form-level fault state is preserved. The token bounds the in-flight pass only; field-level validation tasks that start independently during the awaited window (for example, from user edits) are not linked to this token and continue running.
member.returns: True if there are no validation messages after validation and no async handler faulted; otherwise false.
member.remarks: Validation must not be re-entered. Do not call or from inside an , , or handler attached to the same ; doing so produces undefined behavior.
